summary: FD_TC_056_No Travel Origin, Uncontrollable (delay code 04, upline ATC/airport), APPR
title: No Travel Origin, Uncontrollable (delay code 04, upline ATC/airport), APPR
description:
A single-leg flight is delayed more than 3 hours because of delay code 04 (late positioning due to upline ATC/airport, uncontrollable). The customer chooses not to travel and stays at the origin. Checks that No Travel Origin plus an uncontrollable ATC/airport delay code returns Not Eligible under APPR, with a full ticket refund entitlement.

Prerequisites:
PNR TC043: one adult passenger, one AC domestic leg YUL?YYZ, AC 460, May 28, 2026. Scheduled 10:00 ? 12:00. Actual departure 14:20 (260 min late). Actual arrival 16:25 (265 min late). No cancellation code. First arrival delay code 04 (UA). First departure delay code 04 (UA). Passenger not boarded and coupon not flown. Customer stayed at YUL. No Travel status: Origin. No rebooking accepted.
